text: Whenever life overwhelms us, we call out, “Krishna.”
Whenever joy overflows, we sing, “Hare Krishna.”
Because that Ānanda Swarūpam (embodiment of bliss) draws every heart like no magnet ever could.
We drown in the endless blue of His Prema (divine love).
There is one thing Krishna Himself never gets to experience:
The joy of calling His own name.
The longing for His own darshan (divine sight).
And the sweetness of His love.
That privilege… He gifted to us.
